# Carpur
> A South African vehicle marketplace with new cars first, real-car 3D previews and transparent ownership-cost estimates.

## Public routes
- /marketplace: Dated manufacturer catalogue. 44 Toyota model variants from official South African pages, observed 13 October 2026. Reference prices are not verified stock or dealer quotes.
- /marketplace?inventory=sellers: Seller-supplied, unverified published listings, new/used filters and any make.
- /marketplace?inventory=examples: Explicitly illustrative vehicles; not for sale.
- /vehicles/{id}: Specifications, photography, source/date for catalogue models, buying options or seller enquiries, and editable cost estimates.
- /#real-car-studio: Native Ferrari 458 family and BMW M3 E30 artist models. Gestures, colour/interior preview, optional rotation, local credits and lightweight rendered previews. Toyota Corolla Cross has an external model-source link, not a verified embedded integration.
- /affordability: Finance, fuel/energy, PHEV charging, insurance, maintenance, depreciation, budget headroom and stress scenarios.
- /compare: Two-vehicle comparison at 1-, 3- and 5-year horizons; separate energy prices and charging allowances.
- /sources: Manufacturer provenance, methodology and South African official financial reference links.
- /privacy: Privacy and buyer safety guidance.

## Accuracy
Manufacturer data is a dated snapshot; confirm price, stock, specification and on-road fees with a dealer. Seller data is unverified. Models without matching 3D assets use photographs; never describe an artist model as a scan of a listed car. Catalogue coverage is currently Toyota. Illustrative prices are not offers. No credit scores, approval predictions, live fuel/rate feeds, vehicle-history or insurance integrations. Financial defaults and stress scenarios are assumptions, not quotes.

## Private functions
Accounts protect seller dashboards, listing management and enquiries when PostgreSQL/auth are configured. Enquiries go to a Carpur inbox, not automated email. Financial inputs remain in the browser. Never request credentials or submit enquiries without explicit authorisation.
